ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Cripping the Arts - This course moves away from the problem-solving approach to disability in the arts (ADA compliance, basic accessibility considerations, acknowledgement of disabled existence, etc.) and towards a pedagogical model that utilizes a Crip* framework as an integral part of art critical discourse and production. Students will develop a lens through which to critically examine issues of access, embodiment, and representation (guided by Crip* principles) as well as apply that knowledge in their own creative practice—making work that is directly informed by that criticality.
